scenario: Jordan signs in before a busy workday, opens the Launch week list, captures an accessibility-audit task with a note, moves it to in progress, checks the completed-task filter, switches to Inbox, and loads the next page without losing the selected-list context.

tasks.title: Reply to the accessibility audit before Friday
tasks.notes: Confirm keyboard order, focus visibility, and the empty-state announcement with the design partner.

tasks.title: Polish the landing-page copy
tasks.notes: Keep the headline short enough for the narrow viewport.

tasks.title: Rehearse the stakeholder demo
tasks.notes: Run through the create-list and create-task happy path.

tasks.title: Book dentist appointment
tasks.notes: Ask for the first appointment after 16:00.

tasks.title: Upload receipts from the last trip
Restock pantry staples and refill the water filter
tasks.notes: Use the recurring list at the store.

tasks.title: Send the stakeholder demo notes
tasks.notes: Call out the decisions that need a follow-up owner.

tasks.title: Verify the error monitoring alert
tasks.notes: Use the staging alert and document the expected signal.

tasks.title: Call the vet about the annual checkup
Run the weekend laundry
tasks.notes: Start with towels so they are ready before guests arrive.

required_capabilities: create, rename, and delete list affordances
status changes among todo, in_progress, and done
empty, loading, validation-error, selected, disabled, and long-content states
